$comment: Corrections applied to converted Bible modules by bible/apply-module-overrides.py, keyed by SWORD module name.

sword2bible copies what the .conf says. These entries fix identity (abbreviation clashes), licences the .conf states wrongly, and the attribution, trademark and notice duties of each licence. Each entry cites its evidence in metadata.
Fields: columns (module_info columns), metadata (merged into module_info.metadata), forbid_text (strings that must not remain anywhere in the module).
Biblica CC BY-SA texts: the licence requires a derivative to drop the Biblica(R) trademark, state its changes and carry the attribution line. See docs/lang-bibles.md.
